subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw add true soft-steer semantics beyond current boundary steering, and should that be a new opt-in queue mode or a change to existing steer behavior?
rationale: The requested behavior changes when active runs can be interrupted, how partial output and tool results are preserved, and how injected input is associated with session context; source inspection cannot choose that product contract safely.

options.title: Design Opt-In Soft Steer
options.body: Add a new mode or policy for abort/capture/inject/resume semantics while preserving the current boundary-steer default.

options.title: Keep Boundary Steering Only
options.body: Close or narrow the broad product direction and keep remaining work focused on the narrower active-run ingress tracker.

options.title: Change Steer Globally
options.body: Make existing steer more aggressive by default, accepting compatibility risk for workflows that depend on current boundary behavior.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Soft Steer
recommendation.body: Add a new mode or policy for abort/capture/inject/resume semantics while preserving the current boundary-steer default.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already supplied the recent product/runtime review on this issue and is the clearest observed owner for the lifecycle decision.
